info.name: CantiereSnap Integration Tests
info.description:
Full lifecycle integration tests for the CantiereSnap staging API. Runs sequentially: Auth → Clients → Jobs → Quotes → Status Transitions → Invoice → Dashboard → Error Handling → Cleanup.

Prerequisites:
- Set testPassword environment variable (or pass via --env-var in Newman)
- loginEmail must be a pre-verified Cognito account (defaults to developer account)
- Staging API must be deployed and healthy
